jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description:
*If you’re looking to make the best co-op games in the world, you’ve come to the right place. We're proud to have some of the best game makers and collaborators in the industry working with us. What's more, we're a fun bunch of game developers, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together. Our games are not for everyone. Are they for you?*

**We are now looking for a Backend Developer**
----------------------------------------------

As a Backend Developer, you will play a key role in the design, development, and optimization of our backend systems. You will work closely with a collaborative team of developers and engineers, focusing on technologies such as C#, Microsoft Orleans, ASP.NET Core, Azure, and SQL Server. If you are passionate about building scalable and efficient backend solutions, we want to hear from you.

**Who you are:**

* Proven experience in backend development using C# and ASP.NET Core.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Orleans or other actor model frameworks for distributed and scalable systems.
* Strong expertise in designing and optimizing database structures, preferably with SQL Server.
* Experience with cloud technologies, particularly Azure.
* Understanding of different backend architectural styles and best practices.
* Not required but beneficial if you have experience with Kubernetes and frontend development

**What you'll do:**

* Application Development: Design and develop backend solutions using C#, ASP.NET Core, and Microsoft Orleans, ensuring high performance, scalability, and maintainability.
* Cloud Integration: Utilize Azure services to build and optimize cloud-based backend components, ensuring seamless integration with our applications.
* Database Management: Design and implement efficient database structures using SQL Server, optimizing data storage, and retrieval for optimal system performance.
* Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, provide technical insights, and ensure the successful delivery of projects.
* Third-party platforms: Build, monitor and maintain integrations with third party platforms.

**Our tech stack**

* NET/C#, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, Azure, SQL Server, CosmosDB, Redis, Grafana, Angular, TypeScript

##### **How to apply**

If you think that this position matches your background and skills, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV in English as soon as possible. We ask that your application always include relevant work samples or a link to your portfolio.

We interview candidates continuously and hire when we find a good fit.

##### **Practical Information**

**Scope:** Full-time: 40 hours per week with initial 6 month probation period.  
**Location:** Office first, hybrid solution possible. You need to be eligible to work in Sweden.

**We are a pet friendly office! You can expect to find dogs and occasionally some cats around.**

##### **What we offer**

Arrowhead Game Studios is a growing team of about 100+ people, best known for our co-op titles. Despite our size, we remain a friendly and down to earth bunch, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together.

Located in a newly built, custom-tailored offices on the Hammarby Kaj waterfront, we enjoy everything Stockholm has to offer. A thriving game dev scene, along with all types of activities are immediately available on our doorstep.

Our talented developers are crucial to our success, therefore we put a lot of emphasis in creating and maintaining a prosperous culture. We’re committed to open and transparent communication. Your ideas are welcomed, valued, appreciated - the ceiling for creative discussions is high.

We also have numerous work benefits for all our employees. You can read about them here!

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your career? At PwC, we bring together different perspectives to help develop tomorrow's businesses and organisations. We share a common ambition to build trust, create positive change and deliver long-term sustainable value.

Are you an experienced fullstack developer who enjoys solving complex problems, improving software quality and helping others grow? At PwC, you will have the opportunity to develop reliable digital solutions that support our business and create long-term value for colleagues, clients and other stakeholders.

**Join PwC's Business Support organisation**

PwC's Business Support organisation brings together specialist functions that support and develop our internal operations. This role sits within the IT integrations team, which develops and supports APIs and local integrations with PwC's global solutions.

As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will develop and support APIs and local integrations that manage the flow of data between global platforms and local internal applications. You will combine hands-on development with technical leadership, helping colleagues and stakeholders translate business and user needs into secure, maintainable and reliable solutions.

**Your responsibilities**

In this role, you will:

* Design, develop, test and maintain applications throughout the full development lifecycle.
* Translate business and user needs into reliable technical solutions in collaboration with stakeholders, architects, testers and other delivery teams.
* Act as a senior technical colleague by mentoring less experienced developers, reviewing their work and sharing knowledge across the team.
* Improve application quality and maintainability through automated testing, code reviews, refactoring, documentation and the structured reduction of technical debt.
* Take ownership of complex solutions end to end, from technical design and development through deployment and production support, while aligning decisions with the Tech Lead and the team’s strategic direction.
* Contribute to the team's culture and ways of working, including agile practices as well as pair and mob programming where appropriate.
* Communicate blockers, technical considerations and recommendations clearly to support timely decisions and effective collaboration.
* Use feedback and reflection to continuously develop your own skills and contribute to the development of the team.
* Handle complex development initiatives with limited oversight and resolve difficult technical problems in collaboration with the Tech Lead and the wider team.

**To perform well in the role**

We are looking for someone with substantial experience in backend-focused fullstack development and modern software development practices. You can lead complex technical solutions with limited supervision and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You bring extensive experience in backend development and systems integration using C# and .NET, together with deep practical knowledge in several of the following areas:

* REST APIs
* Entity Framework
* SQL
* Microsoft Azure
* CI/CD pipelines
* Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform
* Azure DevOps Services or a similar platform
* Automated testing, code reviews and modern development practices

Experience with Angular, JavaScript or TypeScript is advantageous, although frontend development is not currently a primary focus of the portfolio. Experience across every technology listed above is not required. We are interested in your overall technical capability, your ability to learn and the experience you can bring to the team.

You communicate effectively in English, both in writing and in speech. Swedish language skills are advantageous.

**Who you are**

You work well with others and value building effective professional relationships. You approach complex challenges with curiosity, structure and sound judgement. You express ideas clearly, take responsibility for results and contribute to an inclusive environment where team members learn from one another and solve challenges together.

You enjoy combining hands-on development with technical guidance and seeing both colleagues and solutions evolve.

**What we offer**

At PwC, you will work with modern technologies in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, continuous learning and professional development are part of everyday work. You will have the opportunity to shape technical solutions, lead complex development efforts and help deliver dependable digital services that add value across the organisation.

jobs.title: Commercial Solar PV Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Join Us**

Bord Gáis Energy has been powering the nation’s homes and businesses for 50 years. Today we are evolving from a utility supplier to a total energy solutions provider – combining trusted gas and electricity expertise with a growing portfolio of net zero products and services. We are at the forefront of Ireland’s energy transition strengthening energy security and helping customers moves to a low carbon future. Ardrar Ltd, recently acquired by Bord Gáis Energy (part of Centrica plc), is scaling rapidly as a leading provider of solar solutions across Ireland.

This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth business, leveraging the strength of an established and trusted brand, Bord Gáis Energy, in the Irish market, backed by an international energy group (Centrica Plc).

**Your Team (Ardrar Ltd – A Bord Gáis Energy Company)**

Ardrar Ltd, part of the Bord Gáis Energy family, is one of Ireland’s fastest-growing providers of smart, sustainable energy solutions. We combine the agility of a rapidly scaling, technology-led business with the strength and reach of an established brand and energy leader in the Irish market

**Employment Terms**

This role is employed by Ardrar Ltd, which operates under separate terms and conditions to Bord Gáis Energy. Together we’re helping homes, farms and businesses cut costs, reduce emissions, and transition to cleaner energy.

**The Role**

We are seeking a **Commercial Solar PV Design Engineer** to support the next phase of transformation as we accelerate our transition to a more sustainable energy future. This role is central to our technical delivery, responsible for designing optimised, compliant, and cost-effective solar PV systems for commercial, industrial, and agricultural customers across Ireland.

You will work closely with our sales, project management, and installation teams to translate customer requirements and site conditions into engineered solutions that maximise energy yield, meet grid connection requirements, and align with project budgets and timelines.

**Core Responsibilities**

*System Design & Engineering*

* Design and develop detailed solar PV proposals for rooftop and ground-mounted commercial solar PV systems (typically 50 kWp to 5 MWp).
* Conduct virtual and physical site assessments to evaluate solar resources, perform shading analysis, and determine optimal system configuration.
* Create detailed technical reports including module layouts, string configurations, and array designs that maximise energy production while respecting structural, electrical, and fire safety constraints.
* Prepare single-line diagrams (SLDs), three-line diagrams, panel layouts, wiring diagrams, and earthing/lightning protection designs.
* Perform DC and AC cable sizing, voltage drop calculations, and protection device coordination.
* Select and specify major equipment including PV modules, inverters, mounting structures, combiner boxes, and balance of system components.
* Use industry-standard software (PVsyst, Helioscope, or equivalent) to perform energy yield simulations and estimate system production.
* Conduct shading and loss analysis, incorporating weather data, soiling assumptions, degradation rates, and system performance ratios.

*Cross-Functional Collaboration*

* Provide technical support to the commercial sales team during the tender and proposal stage, including design, yield estimates, and equipment specifications.
* Create detailed pricing files including full Bill of Materials (BOM) for each project.
* Liaise with suppliers to get up to date pricing for materials.
* Work closely with project managers to resolve design-related RFIs, review contractor submittals, and support construction-phase engineering.
* Collaborate with structural and civil engineers on racking, foundation, and roof loading assessments for complex installations.
* Provide technical guidance to installation and commissioning teams, troubleshooting design or construction issues in the field.

*Technical Documentation & Compliance*

* Prepare engineering deliverables including stamped drawings, design specifications, equipment submittal and as-built drawings.
* Ensure all designs comply with Irish and EU standards, building regulations, ESB Networks grid connection requirements, and SEAI grant specifications.
* Support pre-install team by preparing technical documentation for ESB Networks and local authority planning submissions.

**Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Renewable Energy Engineering, Civil/Structural Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent relevant industry experience).
* Minimum 2–4 years' experience in commercial or utility-scale solar PV system design.
* Proficiency in solar design software such as PVsyst, Helioscope, Opensolar or equivalent.
* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD or similar CAD software for producing construction-ready drawings.
* Solid understanding of solar PV technology, electrical systems, and grid interconnection requirements.
* Knowledge of Irish and EU electrical standards, building regulations, and ESB Networks grid connection processes.
* Experience preparing single-line diagrams, cable sizing calculations, and Bills of Materials.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Full clean driver's license (some site visits required).

**Why should you apply?**

This is your chance to shape Ireland’s clean energy future. You’ll work in a fast-growing business, collaborate with top talent, and accelerate your development every step of the way. This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth business with the backing of a national energy leader with a trusted heritage brand, Bord Gáis Energy is part of Centrica plc, a leading international energy and services company. Benefit from the scale, investment, and expertise of the Bord Gáis Energy / Centrica Group.

Help us, help you. We would love for you to share any information about yourself throughout our recruitment process so that we can better understand you and help shape your journey.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: €55,000.00-€65,000.00 per year

Experience:

* Relevant: 1 year (required)

Work Location: In person
